summary: Repaired node1’s document reader. It now completes 500 reads with a soft open-file limit of 64, consistently returns length 42, closes resources on exceptions, preserves the count argument and document, and remains functional after reboot.

The installed implementation uses `with open(...)`; an injected read failure confirmed context exit, closed resource, and unchanged descriptor count.
